Internal dataset of an AI assistant producing structured, step-by-step project plans.

- Data lives in `data/entries.dat` (one JSON object per line, fields: `prompt`, `response`).

{"prompt": "I want to launch a small online store selling handmade candles within 2 months. Help me plan it out.", "response": "Here's an 8-week structure:

Weeks 1-2 (Foundation): Finalize 6-10 core products, source suppliers for wax/wicks/fragrance, settle on pricing and margins, register your business name.

Weeks 3-4 (Build): Set up your storefront (Shopify or Etsy), take product photos, write listings, set up payment and shipping.

Weeks 5-6 (Inventory + Legal): Produce initial stock (aim for 2-3x expected first-month sales), get any required candle-safety labeling sorted, set up basic bookkeeping.

Weeks 7-8 (Launch): Soft-launch to friends/email list for feedback, fix issues, then go public with a small paid ad push and social content.

Want me to break any single week into a day-by-day checklist?"}
{"prompt": "Plan out a study schedule for the MCAT over the next 4 months, I work part-time.", "response": "Given part-time work, plan roughly 15-20 hours/week across 16 weeks:

Weeks 1-6 (Content review): Work through one subject area per week (Biology, Biochem, Chem/Phys, Psych/Soc, CARS practice daily), using a content review book plus spaced-repetition flashcards.

Weeks 7-10 (Practice + gaps): Full-length practice exams every 10-12 days, spend remaining time drilling your weakest section from each exam's score breakdown.

Weeks 11-14 (Intensive practice): Increase to 2 full-lengths per week with thorough review of every wrong answer, not just right ones.

Weeks 15-16 (Taper): Light review only, no new material, protect sleep, take your last full-length at least 5 days before test day.

Want a weekly hour breakdown too?"}
{"prompt": "We need to migrate our team's project management from spreadsheets to a proper tool in the next quarter. Help me plan the rollout.", "response": "Month 1 (Evaluate + decide): Shortlist 2-3 tools based on your actual workflows, run a 1-week pilot with a small volunteer group on real work, get buy-in from team leads before committing.

Month 2 (Migrate + configure): Map your spreadsheet columns to tool fields, migrate active projects first (not historical ones), set up templates and automations, write a one-page 'how we use this' doc.

Month 3 (Adopt + reinforce): Run the tool in parallel with spreadsheets for week 1 only as a safety net, then go tool-only. Hold two short office-hours sessions for stragglers, and revisit after 6 weeks to fix friction points people actually hit.

Want a RACI chart for who owns each phase?"}
</tool_response>

Weeks 1-4 (Outline + research): Build detailed chapter outline with 10-12 chapters, gather all sources and data points, write book proposal including target audience and positioning, commit to a daily word count goal (1,000-1,500 words).

Weeks 19-22 (Line edit + design): Hire a line editor or beta-reader group for polish, finalize manuscript, order cover design (hire a pro — this is your #1 marketing asset), order interior formatting for both print and eBook.

Weeks 23-24 (Publish + launch): Upload to Amazon KDP and/or IngramSpark, set up author page, pre-order campaign starts, write 10-15 blog/social posts for launch week, coordinate with ARC reviewers to post reviews on day one.

final_entries.prompt: I have 12 weeks to renovate my kitchen on a moderate budget. What should the timeline look like?
final_entries.response:
Here is a phased 12-week kitchen renovation plan:

Weeks 11-12 (Appliances + punch list): Install stove, fridge, dishwasher, sink/faucet. Walk through room with contractor to catch paint touch-ups, caulk gaps, and adjust any cabinet doors before final payment.

Want a budget allocation breakdown by category?
